answer: Not by much. K2 is 8,611 metres (28,251 ft) tall, about 238 m (781 ft) lower than Everest. That's roughly 3% shorter, and it's still the second-highest mountain on Earth [1][2]. It sits in the Karakoram range on the border between Pakistan and China. Although it's lower, it's generally considered a harder and more dangerous climb than Everest, with one of the highest death rates of any 8,000-metre peak [1].
